subject: SummitLight Playbook Studio — tactical plan for joint case-study webinar & blog swap
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@summitlight.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: joint case-study webinar + blog swap for October

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the quick chat yesterday. SummitLight had a strong interest in a short, tactical joint program that pairs a 40-minute case-study webinar (customer + SummitLight + Redwood) with a follow-up blog swap and an accompanying 20-minute technical demo we can host at your booth at SaaS Forward.

Attached is a first-pass agenda and a rough workload split (SummitLight owns the customer intro + logistics; Redwood owns demo and follow-up content). High-level asks:
- Date window: week of Oct 18–22 (preferred Oct 20)
- 30–45 minute webinar, recorded, with short live demo segment
- Co-authored blog within 2 weeks post-webinar (drafts exchanged)
- Optional conference demo slot (booth) and a 20-minute technical session at SaaS Forward day 2

Can you confirm availability and any mandatory compliance items from Redwood side? Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call to lock dates and ownership.

Best,
Anna
Partnerships Lead, SummitLight
anna@summitlight.io

Attachments: SummitLight_Redwood_Joint-Agenda_v2.pdf (13 KB)
